Game Overview

At its heart, Prison Escape Game is a escape game about become a wrongly accused inmate in a thrilling quest for freedom. Outsmart vigilant guards by solving intricate puzzles and navigating hidden passages. With each level increasing in complexity, only strategic thinking and timing will help you escape the intense high-security prison environment. Can you secure your freedom?
